name: What is an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Attached Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary living space built onto an existing primary residence. It shares at least one common wall with the main house but functions as an independent unit, including its own kitchen, bathroom, sleeping area, and entrance. Attached ADUs provide flexible housing options, often used for family members, rental income, or additional living space without requiring a completely separate structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: An attached ADU is a secondary living unit built onto an existing home, sharing a wall and having its own facilities and entrance.
